objective: Tune HistGradientBoosting hyperparameters and test whether local CV improvement transfers to Kaggle public leaderboard.

agent_runs.summary: Ran 36 HistGradientBoosting candidates, selected hgb_004, submitted to Kaggle, and recorded public score.

summary: Best CV accuracy improved to 0.812261, but public leaderboard score decreased to 0.802430 versus exp-006 public score 0.803830.
next_actions: Keep exp-006 as the public leaderboard baseline.
Prefer robustness checks before the next submission.
Consider CatBoost or LightGBM via uv add.
